title: Compression Algorithm for Market Data
description: Collaborated with 4-person development team to create a custom hybrid compression algorithm utilizing huffman, lz77, and delta encoding, and reduced market data storage by 70 percent while maintaining sub-millisecond latency.

title: MBTI Predictor
description: Engineered a recommendation engine processing media content (Instagram posts scraped using GraphAPI), utilizing collaborative filtering and content-based algorithms to suggest personalized movies, music, and connect users with similar MBTI profiles.

title: Modal and Nodal
description: Developed a web scraping algorithm to produce a database of preeminent jazz musicians to facilitate scale research into recording session collaborations to regional influences in the music community. Employed Rust for web scraping and data manipulation, leveraging its performance and safety features.

title: SoccerMatchPro
description: Engineered a comprehensive full-stack web application to showcase a machine learning-based soccer match prediction model
